== Haskell Cheatsheet (haskell-tools.nvim)

*Leader* = `Space`

→ Back to xref:editor/keybindings.adoc[main cheatsheet] · Full guide:
../guides/haskell.md

== GHCi REPL

[cols=",,",options="header",]
|===
|Keys |Mode |Action
|`++<++leader++>++rr` |Normal |Toggle GHCi REPL for the current package
|`++<++leader++>++rf` |Normal |Toggle GHCi REPL for the current file
|`++<++leader++>++rq` |Normal |Quit the GHCi REPL
|===

== haskell-tools Extras

[cols=",,",options="header",]
|===
|Keys |Mode |Action
|`Space-cl` |Normal |Run code lenses (haskell-language-server)
|`Space-hs` |Normal |Hoogle search for type under cursor
|`Space-ea` |Normal |Evaluate all code snippets in the buffer
|===

== Commands

Created when the first Haskell buffer opens; HLS need not be attached.

[cols=",",options="header",]
|===
|Command |Action
|`:Haskell repl toggle [file]` |Toggle GHCi for `file` (default: current buffer)
|`:Haskell repl load [file]` / `reload` / `quit` |Load a file / send `:r` / quit
|`:Haskell repl cword_type` / `cword_info` |Type / info of the word under the cursor
|`:Haskell repl paste_type [reg]` / `paste_info [reg]` |Type / info of a register (default `"`)
|`:Haskell projectFile` / `packageCabal` / `packageYaml` |Open the project / package file
|`:Haskell log setLevel \{level}` |Set the log level
|`:Haskell log openLog` / `openHlsLog` |Open the haskell-tools / HLS log
|`:Hls start` / `stop` / `restart` |Control the HLS client
|`:Hls evalAll` |Run all eval code lenses (same as `Space-ea`)
|===

== LSP (haskell-language-server)

haskell-tools manages the HLS connection automatically. The standard LSP
keys (`gd`, `K`, `gr`, `++<++leader++>++rn`, `++<++leader++>++ca`,
`++<++leader++>++e`, `++[++d`/`++]++d`) are active in Haskell buffers —
see lsp.md.
